reviews.t: Cut in half if they are too dramatic for you!
reviews.x: These lashes are the bomb!  They were a bit too long for me, and I prefer a half lash, so I cut off the inner 1/3 of the lash, and they are perfect!  I use my normal liner to create a winged liner, and then use the magnetic liner to line over it just what I need to adhere the lashes so I don't waste product.  They stay on all day, even in higher winds, and are so light I forget that they are on.

reviews.t: The liner/glue is horrible, but I loved the lashes
reviews.x: I bought this for the eyeliner, which was the worst eyelash liner glue I have ever used. I ended up loving the lashes though, so I am reordering for those. I purchased Kiss Lash Liner/Glue, which is $9 on its own, but definitely worth it compared to this “liner glue.” I’m giving the whole product a 2 because you can’t wear the lashes if you don’t have a halfway decent adhesive.  (Don’t mind my awful photos, I’m no makeup expert, but these lashes are fab!)

Nice full lashes. Not heavy on the lids. Easy to use. Magnets are not visible as I’ve seen on other magnetic lashes. This made removal easier. Other magnetic lashes with block magnets across strip pull eyeliner off with it and I have to detach manually. Did not have that issue with these. Did have a small corner lift while outdoor shopping during a 100+ degree day but nothing a quick touch up of liner couldn’t fix. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Pretty lashes and super quick and easy to apply.
reviews.x: These lashes are really beautiful. I love to wear lashes but never have time to wear them. I take way to long to do my makeup and never enough time to apply lashes. These take no time, apply the eyeliner( a step in my makeup routine i never skip). Then put the lash on the eyeliner. So simple. Other tan that they arrived fast with no issue. I would definitely order again.

Lightweight, a little hard to use at first but got easier with more practice. They’re pretty soft which I love and they don’t take much to remove like with normal lashes and glue. The glue also doesn’t stick to your real lashes which is a common issue I used to have using things like Duo glue. 10/10 recommend I love them

claims.text: Many reviewers find the eyeliner-and-lash system easy to apply and long-lasting, holding up through heat, sweat, and water.
Several reviewers report the lashes did not stick or stay on, with corners falling off or lashes coming loose during wear.
Some reviewers note the lashes are very long or dramatic, and mention cutting them down for a better fit.
A few reviewers experienced irritation or a burning reaction from the magnetic eyeliner.
Some reviewers say the hold only lasts a few hours rather than all day.
